GMs may apply penalties for exceptionally unlikely tasks. **Includes Shrinking modifiers. ***Without Defensive Roll.
ficha_publicada.complicacoes: d og: Rex is a dog and that imposes rather obvious limitations. However, he’s a genius dog that can talk, so these limitations don’t come up much. His Feature (Wonder Dog) lets him attempt tasks he has no business trying as a canine, such as riding a horse or driving a car.
